title: Geometry, pseudo-labels and neighborhoods
notes: Geometry runs retrain the Phase-1 configurations with seed 2 and measure after every epoch. All values use this one seed and four folds. Five-seed results are in ergebnisuebersicht.csv.
CUB was not tracked. In-Shop, labeled classes is the series with fully labeled classes, its budget is the share of labeled classes.

LRML in the geometry runs on Cars196, In-Shop and the In-Shop series uses the configuration of a search with univariate TPE, so its neighbor counts and MAP@R differ from Phase 1 and from the interventions (up to 5.1 percentage points on Cars196, 1.9 on In-Shop, 3.4 on the In-Shop series).
Left out of the means because a fold has no value at the selected epoch (In-Shop, labeled classes): SLADE with Circle at 25 %, SLADE with Proxy-Anchor at 50 %, ÜBl. with NT-Xent at 50 %.

sections.title: Geometry of the embedding space
sections.intro: Section 5.7 of the thesis. Means over the five losses of four fold models at the epoch selected by validation, whole training pool. π intra is the spread within classes, π inter the distance between class centers, π ratio = π intra / π inter (smaller means more compact classes), ρ the spectral decay. Prototype accuracy is the share of unlabeled images whose nearest class prototype is correct. geometry.csv has every loss and the values on the validation classes.

sections.title: Quality of the LP pseudo-labels
sections.intro: Section 5.6.2 of the thesis. Geometry runs with the selected configuration, seed 2, means over four folds, whole unlabeled pool. Coverage is the share of unlabeled images with an accepted pseudo-label, accuracy the share of those that are right according to the hidden labels, first and last meaning the first and the last update of a fold. Right stays right and wrong corrected compare only these two updates for images that had a pseudo-label at both. Wrong, same class is the share of initially wrong labels that still name the same class. Same make is the share of wrong labels naming a car of the same manufacturer, about 14 % under random confusion.

sections.title: Neighborhood structure
sections.intro: Section 5.6.3 of the thesis. Graph purity is the share of kNN edges between images of the same class in the training pool, measured with the neighbor count and weighting of the mechanism, before training and at the selected epoch (geometry runs, seed 2, means over four folds). ÜBl. uses one graph with ten neighbors for comparison. The interventions change the graph of LP and LRML in the Phase-2 runs.
